# Snow Day Forecaster

> A free snow day calculator for any US ZIP code. It estimates the probability that a school
> closes, goes remote or delays, from the current weather forecast and a logistic model trained
> on how 20 large US school districts actually decided in winter 2025-26. Published by Omnia
> Ventures. Not affiliated with any school district, weather service or news outlet.

## What this site is and is not

- It forecasts the **probability** of a closure. It is not a closure announcement and carries no
  live list of closed schools; districts announce on their own channels, usually 4:30-6am.
- Every accuracy claim is backed by a published back-test with its misses listed. Model version
  2026-09-29.

## Key figures (winter 2025-26 back-test, 20 US districts)

- School days tested: 1,345; closed or remote days: 83; delay days: 22.
- AUC 0.953. Brier score 0.033, which is 42% better than forecasting the base rate.
- At a 50% cut-off: 45% of closures caught, 76% of those calls correct.
- Each district was scored by a model trained only on the other 19 (leave-one-district-out).
- 64% of closure days had less than 1 inch of new snow in the previous 48 hours. Ice and
  leftover snow pack close more schools than fresh snowfall does.
- New snow needed for a 50% chance of closure, by region:
  - Northern snow belt: 6.2 in (80% chance: 11.1 in; cold-only closing near -35°F wind chill)
  - Northeast: 5.2 in (80% chance: 9.0 in; cold-only closing near -16°F wind chill)
  - Midwest: 2.8 in (80% chance: 5.3 in; cold-only closing near -11°F wind chill)
  - Mid-Atlantic: 3.2 in (80% chance: 4.9 in; cold-only closing near -20°F wind chill)
  - Border South: 1.9 in (80% chance: 3.1 in; cold-only closing near -15°F wind chill)
  - South: 1.0 in (80% chance: 1.5 in; cold-only closing near -15°F wind chill)

## Attribution

If you quote these figures, please cite Snow Day Forecaster (https://www.snowdayforecaster.com) and link to the page you
used. The closure dataset is offered under CC BY 4.0.

## Machine-readable

- https://www.snowdayforecaster.com/api/summary.json — model, back-test and headline figures
- https://www.snowdayforecaster.com/api/states.json — per-state thresholds and the cities on each live board (CC BY 4.0)

## Source data

- Forecasts: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0) with a National Weather Service fallback.
- Closure ground truth: district announcements and local news, one source per event, listed at
  https://www.snowdayforecaster.com/2025-26-closures/
